snip.cap: ASV Francia 3 f. 248r (DECODE R9), Paris, 14 December 1553: three cipher lines struck through, the same postscript written in clear beneath
snip.credit: Archivio Apostolico Vaticano, Segreteria di Stato, Nunziatura di Francia 3 f. 248r, via DECODE R9

system: Papal nunciature cipher: homophonic alphabet of 1- and 2-digit elements (e.g. A = 28|38|8), 1 as null/separator, dotted code groups; key reconstructed by Lasry 2020.
